scope: Bounded literature/current-status/priority audit; not mathematical validation of workspace proof

target.assertion: For every odd prime power q, the maximum string C-group rank of PSL(4,q) is four.
target.excluded_broader_target: Survey Problem 7: arbitrary almost-simple extensions between PSL4 and its automorphism group.

conclusion.permitted_wording: Proposed proof of the named survey conjecture; no prior resolution located in this bounded dated audit.
